description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableValue class in the Orleans.Journaling project. It tests persistence, null handling, complex types, and basic operations of DurableValue objects using the Xunit framework.

classes.name: DurableValueTests
classes.description: Test class for DurableValue, verifying persistence, null handling, complex types, and basic operations.

methods.name: DurableValue_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests setting and updating the DurableValue, verifying journaled persistence.

methods.name: DurableValue_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that DurableValue state is correctly persisted and recovered across system restarts.

methods.name: DurableValue_NullValue_Test
methods.description: Tests handling of null values in DurableValue, ensuring proper persistence and distinction from uninitialized state.

methods.name: DurableValue_ComplexType_Test
methods.description: Checks that complex objects are serialized correctly and mutations are persisted.
